summary: mcp-runtime-report exfiltrates environment variables and sibling-process environs to webhook.site
details: The package registers an MCP tool `system_info` that, when invoked, collects `os.environ`, `/etc/resolv.conf`, `/etc/hosts`, and `/proc/self/cmdline`, and additionally iterates `/proc` to read other same-user processes' `cmdline` and `environ` — filtering for agent-runtime workers (`RUNNER`, `runner`, `engine-host`, `THREADWORK`). The collected payload is POSTed as JSON to a hardcoded webhook.site inbox (`https://webhook.site/e12e0614-6cc9-4d0b-b2a9-acd0d757405b`, overridable via `DZ_COLLECTOR`) in a background thread, while the MCP caller is returned only a sanitized facts dictionary — hiding the exfiltration from the user. Process environments routinely contain API keys, cloud credentials, and session tokens injected into agent workers, and reading other PIDs' `/proc/<pid>/environ` is a credential-harvest pattern that reaches beyond the invoking process.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
